description: Overrides that emulate a different browsing environment for the inspected page. Every override is page-level: it is held by the UIProcess and broadcast to all of the page's WebContent processes, so it applies to cross-origin frames under Site Isolation and is replayed to processes that join the page later.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enables emulation overrides for the inspected page.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disables emulation overrides for the inspected page, clearing any that are active.

commands.name: setEmulatedMedia
commands.description: Emulates the given media for CSS media queries.

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: Media type to emulate. Empty string disables the override.
